1 | PASS | `src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts` implements user registration via Supabase Auth.
2 | PASS | `src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts` implements user login via Supabase Auth.
3 | PASS | `src/app/api/auth/logout/route.ts` implements user logout via Supabase Auth.
4 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` defines durable PostgreSQL tables for users, documents, and chats.
5 | PASS | `src/app/api/documents/route.ts` POST endpoint accepts file uploads and stores them.
6 | FAIL | No API endpoint or UI logic exists to update or replace existing documents; only creation is implemented.
7 | PASS | `src/lib/chroma.ts` and `docker-compose.yml` integrate ChromaDB as the vector database.
8 | PASS | `src/lib/rag.ts` `retrieveContext` generates embeddings and queries Chroma for retrieval.
9 | PASS | `src/components/ChatInterface.tsx` provides the UI to send questions to the assistant.
10 | PASS | `src/app/api/chat/route.ts` calls `retrieveContext` and `generateResponse` for RAG.
11 | PASS | `src/lib/serpapi.ts` and `src/lib/rag.ts` integrate SerpAPI for web search supplementation.
12 | PASS | `src/app/page.tsx` sidebar displays persistent conversation history for the user.
13 | PASS | `src/app/api/chat/route.ts` persists messages to Supabase; `src/app/api/conversations/[id]/messages/route.ts` retrieves them.
14 | PASS | Supabase RLS policies in `supabase_schema.sql` enforce row-level security for data access.
15 | PASS | `src/components/ChatInterface.tsx` includes a microphone button using `react-speech-recognition`.
16 | PASS | `useSpeechRecognition` hook in `ChatInterface.tsx` automatically sets input state from transcript.
17 | PASS | `ChatInterface.tsx` uses a `textarea` for input, allowing users to review and edit text before sending.
18 | FAIL | Uses generic browser Web Speech API; no specific configuration or model selection for legal terminology accuracy is implemented.
19 | PASS | `src/app/api/chat/route.ts` parses `@` syntax from messages to identify referenced documents.
20 | PASS | `src/app/api/chat/route.ts` fetches specific documents by ID from Chroma when `@` references are present.
21 | PASS | `src/lib/rag.ts` `generateResponse` injects referenced document content into the system prompt as high-priority context.
22 | FAIL | The system prompt asks to cite sources, but the code does not enforce or verify that the AI explicitly cites @-mentioned documents in the output.

rubric.4: Application persists all user accounts and all stored documents using durable, database-backed storage.
rubric.5: Application allows users to upload files into the document knowledge base.
rubric.6: Application allows users to update or replace existing uploaded documents.
rubric.7: Application integrates Chroma as the vector database for document storage.
rubric.8: Application embeds and indexes all documents for retrieval within the vector store.
rubric.9: Application provides an AI chat interface that allows users to send questions to the assistant.
rubric.10: Application generates AI responses using retrieval-augmented generation that incorporates relevant documents.
rubric.11: Application integrates web search to supplement retrieval when generating answers.
rubric.12: Application displays a persistent conversation history for each user.
rubric.13: Application persists all chat logs so users can revisit prior conversations.
rubric.14: Application handles all uploaded legal documents securely to protect sensitive information.
rubric.15: Application implements voice dictation functionality that allows users to record spoken questions through a microphone control in the chat interface.
rubric.16: Application automatically transcribes recorded speech into text and places it into the chat input box.
rubric.17: Application allows users to review and edit transcribed text before sending it as a message.
rubric.18: Application ensures transcription quality is sufficient to handle common legal terminology accurately.
rubric.19: Application supports @-referencing of documents using an @-style syntax.
rubric.20: Application retrieves any @-referenced document or set of documents from the vector store in addition to other retrieved materials.
rubric.21: Application passes the content and metadata of all @-referenced documents to the AI assistant as high-priority context during response generation.
rubric.22: Application ensures the AI assistant explicitly cites or references the @-mentioned documents in its response when appropriate, including summarizing or quoting key sections within permissible limits.
